Strings.settings.system_properties.description: Change advanced system settings in their own windows.
Strings.settings.system_properties.environment_h: User and remote machine environment variables.
Strings.settings.performance.title: Performance options
Strings.settings.performance.description: Choose desktop effects that are supported by RelaxKonOS and saved to this workspace.
Strings.settings.performance.animate_controls: Animate controls and elements inside windows
Strings.settings.performance.animate_windows: Animate windows when minimizing and maximizing
Strings.settings.performance.host_note: Changes apply to managed windows and taskbar behavior, and sync with this workspace.
Strings.settings.theme.description: Choose the light or dark appearance for the taskbar and Start menu.
Strings.settings.wallpaper.description: Choose a desktop background preset or your own image.
Strings.settings.wallpaper.sync_hint: Images up to 32 MB are securely stored in this workspace and sync to your other devices.
Strings.settings.wallpaper.size_limit: Choose an image between 1 byte and {0} MB.
Strings.settings.network.not_loaded: Server addresses have not been loaded.
Strings.settings.network.no_addresses: No non-loopback IPv4 or IPv6 addresses were found.
Strings.settings.image_mirrors.description: Configure the registry prefix used when pulling Docker Hub images. Settings belong to the current account and are read by the server when it pulls.
Strings.settings.image_mirrors.hint: Default pulls directly from Docker Hub. Added hosts must be HTTPS Docker Hub-compatible registry prefixes, such as docker.m.daocloud.io; paths, queries, and account details are not supported.
Strings.settings.image_mirrors.default_hint: Do not use a mirror; use Docker's default registry.
Strings.settings.image_mirrors.name: Name
Strings.settings.image_mirrors.required: Enter a name and registry host.
Strings.settings.image_mirrors.default_selected: Docker will pull directly from its default registry.
Strings.settings.image_mirrors.selected: Docker Hub images will be pulled through {0}.
Strings.settings.apps.uninstall_confirmation: Uninstall "{0}"? This deletes the application's locally installed files.
Strings.settings.apps.clear_data_description: Choose the optional data to remove. Local application data is always removed.
Strings.settings.apps.clear_data.local_hint: Always removed from this device. Application installation files are not removed.
Strings.settings.apps.clear_data.permissions_hin: Remove this device's allowed and denied decisions; the app will ask again when opened.
Strings.settings.apps.clear_data.server_hint: Remove all private settings for this application in your current RelaxKonOS account.
Strings.settings.apps.clear_data.complete_permis: Application data and selected permission decisions were cleared.
Strings.settings.apps.clear_data.complete_server: Application data and the selected optional data were cleared.
Strings.settings.palette.description: This palette is shared by the desktop and every built-in application.
Strings.settings.accent.hint: Use #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. Leave it blank to use the selected palette.
Strings.settings.custom_theme.description: Import a theme to add it to this workspace. Custom themes include light and dark variants.
Strings.settings.theme_import.invalid: This file does not contain a valid RelaxKonOS theme.
Strings.settings.theme_import.limit: You can keep up to 20 custom themes.
Strings.settings.theme_import.inaccessible: This theme does not meet the contrast requirements.
Strings.settings.theme_delete.confirmation: Delete the custom theme “{0}”? This cannot be undone.
Strings.settings.save.failed: Save failed. Your draft is retained.
Strings.settings.save.conflict: Changed elsewhere. Reload and merge before saving.
Strings.settings.host_time.title: Remote time zone
Strings.settings.host_time.scope: Remote machine · affects time display for all users. Display formats above belong to the Workspace.
Strings.settings.host_time.load_prompt: Load the remote host to begin.
Strings.settings.host_time.loaded: Remote snapshot loaded. Select a time zone and preview the change.
Strings.settings.host_time.review: Review the difference and plan expiry before applying.
Strings.settings.host_time.authorization_cancell: Authorization was cancelled; no apply request was sent.
Strings.settings.host_time.outcome_unknown: Outcome is uncertain. Query the operation ID before another write.
Strings.settings.host_time.failed: Request failed. The draft is retained; see the error below.
Strings.settings.host_time.administrator: Windows administrator (optional; Linux uses current user)
Strings.settings.operation.prepared: Prepared; authorization and apply are still required.
Strings.settings.operation.applied: Applied and read back from the remote OS.
Strings.settings.operation.unknown: Unknown outcome; do not replay the write.
Strings.settings.operation.rolledback: Previous configuration restored and read back.
Strings.settings.operation.recoveryrequired: Recovery required; inspect the operation before further changes.
Strings.settings.time.affects_host_time_display: Changes the remote machine time zone for all users; does not change the system clock.
Strings.settings.search.no_results: No matching settings. Try a different keyword.
Strings.settings.time.platform_unsupported: Time zone changes are not supported on this platform
Strings.settings.environment.title: Environment variables
Strings.settings.environment.effect: Saved changes affect new processes. Running processes retain their environment.
Strings.settings.environment.user_hint: Unchecked: remote authenticated user. Linux user environment applies to RelaxKonOS-launched processes.
Strings.settings.environment.edit_hint: Select a variable or enter a new name. Masked values are not copied into the editor. Staging an empty value stores an empty string; delete is a separate action.
Strings.settings.environment.name: Variable name
Strings.settings.environment.delete_confirm: Delete environment variable "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
Strings.settings.environment.path_hint: Order, duplicates and empty entries are preserved. Empty entries may search the current directory. Removing the last entry leaves an empty value. Stage set to include these edits in the batch. Remote path existence has not been checked.
Strings.settings.environment.path_separator: An entry cannot contain the remote PATH separator.
Strings.settings.environment.path_current_direct: Empty PATH entries may enable current-directory search.
Strings.settings.environment.path_duplicates: PATH contains duplicate entries; they have been preserved.
Strings.settings.account.title: Account & Security
Strings.settings.account.description: The login alias belongs to your existing system account and workspace. This setting does not affect SSH, file sharing, or the OS account.
Strings.settings.account.current_password: Current password for the selected method
Strings.settings.account.alias_hint: 3–32 lowercase ASCII characters, starting with a letter
Strings.settings.account.password_mismatch: Enter your current password and matching new passwords.
Strings.settings.account.confirm.create: Verify your OS password to create the alias. System login will remain enabled.
Strings.settings.account.confirm.rename: Verify your current password to rename the alias. Existing sessions remain connected.
Strings.settings.account.confirm.password: Changing the alias password signs out every session, including this one. Sign in again afterward.
Strings.settings.account.confirm.delete: Verify your OS password. Deleting the alias restores direct system login and signs out every session.
Strings.settings.account.confirm.toggle: Disabling requires the current alias password; enabling requires the current OS password. SSH and OS access are unaffected.
Strings.settings.account.failed: The operation was not confirmed. Review the refreshed configuration before trying again.
Strings.settings.account.load_failed: Could not read account security. Reconnect or reload.
Strings.settings.account.unavailable: Account eligibility is unavailable. Contact the server operator.
Strings.settings.account.unavailable.linux-pam-a: Alias support awaits verification of this Linux PAM stack. Use system login.
Strings.settings.account.unavailable.windows-dom: Domain alias support is not verified. Use system login.
Strings.settings.account.unavailable.account-sta: The server cannot read the current account state.
Strings.settings.account.unavailable.account-ine: The system account is not eligible for an alias (disabled, locked, or expired).
Strings.settings.account.unavailable.identity-mi: The system account identity does not match the registry. The alias has been revoked.
Strings.settings.account.error.alias-revision-co: Settings changed elsewhere. Review the refreshed state.
Strings.settings.account.error.alias-unavailable: This alias or account cannot be used.
Strings.settings.account.error.alias-not-configu: No alias is configured yet. Create one first.
Strings.settings.account.error.authentication-un: Authentication service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
Strings.settings.account.error.invalid-input: Check the alias format and password length (8–128 characters)
Strings.settings.account.error.login-rate-limite: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
Strings.settings.account.saved_cleanup_failed: Update the saved login for this server manually.
